key_finding: Nebius's counterparty map at FY2025 has three structural anchors: (a) the customer base — disclosed as 'over half' of $7-9B FY2026 ARR target already contracted, but specific named customers are not publicly disclosed at customer-name level (this is consistent with hyperscaler-adjacent enterprise contracting practice); (b) the supplier base — Nvidia is the dominant GPU supplier and also a strategic equity investor through the August 2025 $700M placement, creating circular alignment; (c) the strategic-investor base — Accel and Orbis joined Nvidia in the $700M placement, with Accel's Matthew Weigand on the board.

core_ai_cloud_business.description: Full-stack AI infrastructure: Nvidia GPU clusters in Nebius-built data centers, with vertically integrated stack from chip-procurement through cooling, networking, software, and operating-system layers. Customer access via Nebius AI Studio and direct enterprise contracting.
core_ai_cloud_business.geographic_footprint: Europe-headquartered (Netherlands corporate domicile) with US expansion underway through 2025-2026. Specific data center locations include Finland (legacy Yandex footprint) and US sites under construction.

portfolio_subsidiaries.name: Toloka AI
portfolio_subsidiaries.description: Human-data labelling platform for AI model training. Operates a global crowd-sourced labour network providing ground-truth labels for vision, language, and multimodal AI training datasets. Revenue model is service-based with hyperscaler and AI lab customers.
portfolio_subsidiaries.strategic_role: Adjacent profitable revenue line that complements the core AI cloud (Toloka customers often overlap with cloud customers).

portfolio_subsidiaries.name: TripleTen
portfolio_subsidiaries.description: Online tech education / coding-bootcamp business focused on data science, software engineering, and AI/ML skills.
portfolio_subsidiaries.strategic_role: Standalone consumer-tech business; consolidates into the group but operates independently with separate management.

portfolio_subsidiaries.name: Avride
portfolio_subsidiaries.description: Autonomous driving technology business. Develops self-driving systems and robotics-related platforms.
portfolio_subsidiaries.strategic_role: Long-cycle moonshot; consolidates into the group as a venture-style holding. Closest analog is Cruise / Waymo / Aurora-scale R&D commitment.

customer_landscape.framing: Nebius's customer base is structurally hyperscaler-adjacent enterprise AI: AI labs and ML model developers, hyperscaler customers who require multi-cloud capacity, enterprise AI customers running training and inference workloads. The 'over half of $7-9B FY26 ARR already contracted' disclosure indicates Nebius is signing multi-year commercial contracts with credit-worthy buyers; specific customer names are not publicly disclosed at the snapshot date.
customer_landscape.comparison_to_corewave_and_lambda: Nebius operates in the same competitive set as CoreWeave (public, NASDAQ:CRWV) and Lambda (private), Crusoe (private), Vultr, and the hyperscaler-internal AI cloud capacity at Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. Nebius's structural advantage versus the pure-play competitors is the $3.7B cash + $834M Q4 operating cash flow + the Nvidia strategic-investor relationship.

supplier_relationships.name: Nvidia
supplier_relationships.role: GPU supplier + strategic equity investor (August 2025 $700M placement)
supplier_relationships.framing: Nvidia's dual role as GPU supplier AND equity investor is the most consequential relationship on the counterparty map. The $700M placement aligned Nvidia's strategic interest with Nebius's capacity build-out; the implied allocation priority for Nvidia's GPU output (H100, H200, B100/B200, Rubin generation) flows from the equity alignment. Specific GPU allocations are not publicly disclosed.

supplier_relationships.name: Data center hardware supply chain
supplier_relationships.framing: Specific vendors not separately disclosed at customer-name level. Customer set likely includes Supermicro, Dell PowerScale / PowerEdge, HPE, Foxconn-FII, and direct ODM suppliers.

supplier_relationships.name: Power utilities and real estate counterparties
supplier_relationships.framing: Connected-power agreements are the highest-stakes operational dependency. Nebius's contracted >2GW exit-2025 vs 170MW active means there is a meaningful pipeline of utility agreements and real estate sites under various stages of build.

strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.name: Accel
strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.framing: Tier-1 venture capital firm; partner Matthew Weigand joined the board concurrent with the placement. Accel's enterprise-software and AI-infrastructure portfolio depth aligns with Nebius's strategic trajectory.

strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.name: Nvidia
strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.framing: Strategic supplier-and-investor alignment as discussed above.

strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.name: Orbis Investments (certain accounts)
strategic_investors_august_2025_placemen.framing: South African-rooted global value investor with patient capital — significant signal of long-duration capital backing the AI-infrastructure thesis.

competitive_set_for_reference.name: CoreWeave (CRWV)
competitive_set_for_reference.framing: Direct public competitor in AI GPU cloud. Larger active capacity but more leveraged balance sheet.

competitive_set_for_reference.name: Lambda (private)
competitive_set_for_reference.framing: Pure-play AI GPU cloud, venture-backed, also Nvidia-aligned.

competitive_set_for_reference.name: Crusoe (private)
competitive_set_for_reference.framing: AI GPU cloud + flared-gas power integration; differentiated power-supply approach.

competitive_set_for_reference.name: Microsoft Azure AI / Google Cloud / AWS
competitive_set_for_reference.framing: Hyperscaler-internal AI cloud capacity; the strategic alternative to which Nebius sells its multi-cloud value proposition.

competitive_set_for_reference.name: Vultr / DigitalOcean Nimbus
competitive_set_for_reference.framing: Lower-tier AI cloud entrants with smaller scale.
